name: tact-extension
description: Personal TACT extension: incremental course downloads, completion-aware Calendar reminders, and ChatGPT attachments

scripts.build:firefox: NODE_ENV=production webpack --config tasks/webpack.config.firefox.js && node tasks/release firefox
scripts.build:safari: NODE_ENV=production webpack --config tasks/webpack.config.safari.js && node tasks/release safari
scripts.convert:safari: NODE_ENV=production npm run build:safari && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist/source/safari --project-location dist/source/safari-proj --app-name "Comfortable-NU" --bundle-identifier "com.das08.ComfortableNU.Safari" --force
scripts.build:all: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox && npm run build:safari && npm run build:edge
scripts.build:chromium: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:edge

author: Kazuki Takeda, Shoji Kajita(Kyoto University), rozwer(Nagoya University)
